_comment: Hand edits on top of the OpenStreetMap draft (scripts/stations/draft_from_osm.py), from the research pass of 2026-10-30 (data/stations/research/fi_HL).

changelog.what: First draft from OSM with the research pass's platform numbers, entrances, heights and amenities.

Platform heights from Digitraffic infra-api platforms (Fintraffic/Väylävirasto, CC BY 4.0); 5 buildings, roofs and footbridges with laser heights; the ground as a 5 m grid (3D research pass, data/stations/research/fi_HL).

1._source: Digitraffic infra-api platforms (Fintraffic/Väylävirasto, CC BY 4.0), Digitraffic infra-api laiturit 1.2.246.586.1.37.3327209, read 2026-10-30, CC BY 4.0: tracks 1, class korkea = 0.55 m above rail, 257 m long; a recorded design class, not a survey
